description: This Java source file defines the class `AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForSavings` which implements the `AccountingProcessorForSavings` interface. It contains logic to create various journal entries for savings account transactions such as deposits, withdrawals, interest postings, fees, penalties, and transfers, using helper methods to generate accounting entries based on transaction types and attributes.

classes.name: AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForSavings
classes.description: A class responsible for processing accrual-based accounting journal entries for savings account transactions, applying various accounting rules based on transaction types.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForSavings
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a list of savings transactions based on their types, handling deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, transfers, overdrafts, and other transaction types, by invoking helper methods to generate appropriate accounting entries.
